title: fix: remove unused variables causing TS6133 build errors
body:
Console build fails due to three TS6133 "declared but its value is never read" errors.

- **`ViewConfigPanel.tsx`**: Remove `onOpenEditor` from function destructuring (retained in `ViewConfigPanelProps` interface — callers unaffected)
- **`ViewConfigPanel.test.tsx`**: Remove unused `...props` rest spreads from `FilterBuilder` and `SortBuilder` mocks
